Gate : coupe franchement. Exp 2:1 / 3:1: Gate: cuts sharply. Exp 2:1 / 3:1 / 4:1 (expander): reduces progressively instead of cutting, for a more natural result. Ducker: lowers this channel when another plays (e.g. background music ducking under speech).
Le niveau en dessous duquel la porte se: The level below which the gate closes. Raise it until noise between notes disappears, without cutting quiet notes.
De combien on baisse quand la porte est: How far the level drops when the gate closes. 60 dB is effectively silent; 10–20 dB is subtler and more natural.
Vitesse d’ouverture. Très courte (0–2 ms: Opening speed. Very short (0–2 ms) for drums, slower to avoid clicks on vocals.
Temps pendant lequel la porte reste ouve: How long the gate stays open after the sound falls below threshold, avoiding chopped note tails.
La porte « écoute » une version filtrée: The gate listens to a filtered version of the sound (or another channel) to decide when to open. For example, remove lows so the kick does not open a tom’s gate.
Points de départ pour kick, caisse clair: Starting points for kick, snare, acoustic guitar and vocals. Then adjust threshold by ear.
Commence sans gate. Ajoute-la seulement: Start without a gate. Add one only if a microphone picks up too much of the other instruments.
L’égaliseur règle le timbre : plus ou mo: The equaliser shapes tone: more or less bass, mids or treble. First cut what gets in the way before adding boosts.
Elle montre l’effet total de l’égaliseur: Shows the overall effect of the equaliser. Above zero is a boost; below zero is a cut. Drag a point left/right for frequency and up/down for gain; the mouse wheel changes its width.
Les 4 bandes (6 sur les bus et la façade: The 4 bands (6 on buses and Main). Each acts around a frequency.
PEQ : une bosse ou un creux autour de la: PEQ: a peak or dip around a frequency. LShv / HShv (shelf): raises or lowers all lows / highs. LCut / HCut: removes everything below / above the cutoff. VEQ: a smoother “vintage” version.
De combien on monte ou baisse, en dB. ±3: How much to boost or cut, in dB. Even ±3 dB is audible.
La fréquence travaillée. Repères : 60–10: The frequency being adjusted. Landmarks: 60–100 Hz = weight; 200–400 Hz = mud or warmth; 1–3 kHz = presence, attack, harshness; 5–10 kHz = brightness, air, sibilance.
La largeur de la bande. Q élevé = étroit: Band width. High Q is narrow and precise (e.g. feedback reduction); low Q is broad and musical.
Active l’égaliseur ou remet tous les gai: Enables the equaliser or resets all gains to zero.
Le coupe-bas de l’entrée, rappelé ici ca: The input high-pass filter, repeated here because it contributes to the curve.
Voix étouffée : baisse un peu vers 300 H: Muffled vocals: cut slightly around 300 Hz. Harsh vocals: cut around 2–3 kHz. Lacking brightness: boost gently above 8 kHz.
Le compresseur réduit les écarts de volu: The compressor reduces level differences by turning down loud passages, keeping the sound steady and present. Particularly useful for vocals and bass.
Comp : réduit les pics. Exp : l’inverse,: Comp: reduces peaks. Exp: the opposite, reducing quiet sounds (rarely useful here).
Le niveau à partir duquel le compresseur: The level above which the compressor acts. Lower thresholds mean more compression.
La force de la compression. 2:1 = léger,: Compression strength. 2:1 is gentle, 4:1 is clear, 10:1 and above behaves as a limiter. At 4:1, 4 dB above threshold becomes 1 dB.
La douceur de l’entrée en action. 0 = br: How gradually compression begins. 0 is abrupt; 5 is very progressive and natural.
Mélange son compressé et son d’origine (: Blends compressed and original sound (parallel compression). 100% is fully compressed.
Vitesse de réaction. Rapide = écrase l’a: Reaction speed. Fast attacks suppress transients; slower attacks (10–30 ms) let drum or bass punch through.
Combien de temps il continue d’agir et à: How long compression continues and how quickly it releases. Too short can cause pumping.
Peak réagit aux pics instantanés, RMS au: Peak responds to instantaneous peaks; RMS to average level (smoother). Lin / Log changes the release shape: keep the default if unsure.
La console choisit attaque et relâchemen: The mixer chooses attack and release based on the signal. A useful default.
Le compresseur ignore une partie du spec: The compressor ignores part of the spectrum when deciding when to act (e.g. ignoring a bass guitar’s low frequencies).
Points de départ pour kick, caisse clair: Starting points for kick, snare, bass and vocals.
Pour une voix : ratio 3:1, seuil réglé p: For vocals: ratio 3:1, threshold set for 3–6 dB reduction on loud passages, attack 10 ms, release 100–150 ms.
Combien ce canal est envoyé à chaque ret: How much of this channel goes to each monitor bus and each effect. This is where each musician’s mix is built.
Les retours (wedges ou in-ear). Le fader: Monitors (wedges or in-ears). The fader sets how much of this channel that bus’s musician hears.
La quantité de signal envoyée à chaque e: The signal level sent to each effect. Higher levels add more reverb or delay to the channel.
D’où part l’envoi. Input / Pre EQ / Post: Where the send taps the signal. Input / Pre EQ / Post EQ: different points before the front-of-house fader. Pre Fader (recommended for monitors): monitor level is unaffected by the front-of-house fader. Post Fader (recommended for effects): the effect follows the fader. Sub Group: follows the group.

Un DCA est une télécommande de volume :: A DCA is a remote volume control: one fader raises or lowers a whole group (all drums, all vocals) without changing its internal balance.
Coupe d’un seul bouton tous les canaux d: Mutes every channel in a group with one button (e.g. all drum microphones between songs).
Mixage automatique pour plusieurs micros: Automatic mixing for multiple speech microphones (conference, theatre): the mixer lowers unused microphones. Also enable it in the right-hand bar.
La famille X-Air a 4 emplacements d’effe: The X-Air family has 4 effect slots shared by the whole band. Feed channels into them through FX sends (reverb, delay…), or insert an effect into a channel.
L’effet chargé dans l’emplacement. Chang: The effect loaded in this slot. Changing its type replaces it for every channel using it: confirmation is required.
Donnent de l’espace : Hall = grande sall: Add space: Hall = large hall, Room = small room, Plate = bright, ideal for vocals.
Répétitions du son (écho). Stereo Delay: Repeats of the sound (echo). Stereo Delay and Tap set the time between repeats.
Épaississent ou font tourner le son, sou: Thicken or swirl the sound, often on guitar or keyboard.
L’emplacement est utilisé directement da: The slot is inserted directly into a channel instead of being used as a send/return effect.
Le fader « FX » de la banque règle le vo: The bank’s FX fader sets the effect level in the front-of-house mix.

Les prises de sortie des retours. Normal: Monitor output sockets. Normally, output 1 receives bus 1, and so on.
Les pistes envoyées à l’ordinateur pour: Tracks sent to the computer for recording. Typically, channel 1 goes to USB 1.
Les 16 canaux envoyés au système de reto: The 16 channels sent to the Behringer P16 personal monitoring system.
À quel endroit du canal on prend le sign: Where the signal is taken from the channel. To record a raw signal, choose AIN or IN (before processing).
Le niveau de chaque point de la console: The level at each point in the console in real time. Green: good; yellow: loud; red at the top: clipping, which should be avoided.
Le niveau de chaque canal. Vise des crêt: Each channel’s level. Aim for peaks around −12 to −6 dB.
